info.title: Tò He Admin API
info.description: The console's API (ADR 0027, 0042), on the console's host with its own session. Every endpoint past the sign-in needs a platform role.

get.summary: What the console needs before anyone signs in: the hub's address.

post.summary: Sign in to the console: email, password and a code; sets the console's own session cookie for twelve hours.

delete.summary: End the console's session on this browser; the hub's session stays.

get.summary: Whether the deployment still waits for its first owner.

post.summary: With the setup token, the account of this email and password becomes the platform's first owner; setup ends for good.

get.summary: The account signed in to the console: its role, what the role may do, and its session; 204 when nobody is.
Accounts, players, rooms, errors, the catalog and the outbox at a glance.
Every game in the registry, listed or not, with its players in the last week and open rooms.
Device telemetry over the last days (1 to 30): errors, frames, metrics per game version.
The running build, its database migrations, background workers and settings without secrets.
The audit log, newest first, a page at a time.

post.summary: The password, or a code from the authenticator, opens step-up level 2 in this console session for 10 minutes.

get.summary: Whether two-factor authentication is on, until when this console session lasts, recovery codes left.

delete.summary: Turn two-factor authentication off: every session of the account ends, this one too (needs step-up level 2).

post.summary: New recovery codes in place of the old ones (needs step-up level 2).

get.summary: Accounts by email, username, name or profile ID (four digits or more); the newest first, fifty at most.
One account: sign-in methods, role, two-factor authentication, suspension, profiles and their names.

post.summary: Suspend an account: no way in, and its sessions end.
Delete for good an account whose owner asked and whose seven days are over (ADR 0038).
End every session of an account.

put.summary: Give an account a platform role, or take it away (owners only).

patch.summary: Rename a profile, under the same name rules; its history keeps the old name.

post.summary: Hide a profile from public boards; its owner's switch does not bring it back.

delete.summary: Let a hidden profile back on public boards, as its owner's switch says.

post.summary: Take a profile — an account's or a device's — off every table it sits at or watches; a bot finishes a hand in progress.

get.summary: Device profiles on the server by name or id; the latest used first, fifty at most.

patch.summary: Rename a device profile on the server — to hide a name — under the same name rules; its history keeps the old name.

get.summary: The sign-in methods, which are on and who signs in only by each; the registration mode.

put.summary: Switch sign-in methods and the registration mode; one method stays on, and you keep a way in.

get.summary: Communities, how many accounts came with each, and their invite codes.

post.summary: A new invite code for the community: given or made up, with an end and a limit of uses if wanted.

delete.summary: Revoke an invite code: no sign-up uses it again.

get.summary: Held results, waiting for a person: oldest first, fifty at a time.
Results people decided about or the engine rejected: the latest decision first, fifty at a time.
One result: where it stands, what its profile did before on the board, its evidence, every decision.
A ranked run's seed and moves to watch in the game itself, and the build that played it while the games origin serves it.

post.summary: Approve a held result: verified when the server refereed or replayed it, checked otherwise.
Reject a result, at any level: it counts on no board.
Reopen a decided result — rejected, checked or verified: held again, for another look.

get.summary: A share link by its code, typed any way codes are read: its maker, state and every count by day.

post.summary: Revoke a share link: it resolves as revoked from now on, and its preview is the generic one.

get.summary: Every agent and its tokens — scopes, made, expiry, revoked, last used — never a token itself.

post.summary: A new agent: a unique name and a note.

get.summary: The scopes an agent token may hold, and what each allows.

post.summary: Disable an agent: every one of its tokens is revoked at once, and it gets no new one.
A new token for the agent, with scopes and an expiry: shown in this answer once, never again.
Revoke a token: its next request is refused.

get.summary: Every use of the agent's tokens, refusals too, newest first, a page at a time.
